display_name: Certain CSA (far majority central events [e.g. >75%] plus high confidence that the scored central events were central)
Likely CSA (predominant CSA with either meaningful proportion of OSA [>=25%] and/or scored central events had obstructive features; somewhat confident that a CSA diagnosis is appropriate)

Highly uncertain (close balance of CSA + OSA, and/or mixed features of OSA and CSA; or particularly difficult to decide on event classification, scorer not confident in classification of respiratory events)
Likely OSA (predominant OSA with either meaningful proportion of CSA [>=25%] and/or scored obstructive events had central features; somewhat confident that an OSA diagnosis is appropriate)
Certain OSA (far majority obstructive events [e.g. >75%] plus high confidence that the scored obstructive events were obstructive)
